item.title: Anthropic Is Said to Guide IPO Price to Top of Range or Above
item.description: Anthropic PBC is guiding prospective investors in its initial public offering it expects to price the shares at the high end of the price range or above, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Anthony Hughes

item.title: Trump Arrives in Asia Ahead of Summit with Xi, Putin
item.description: US President Donald Trump kicked off a three-day trip to Asia on Tuesday, meeting regional leaders and saying he’s open to a one-on-one meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin later in the week. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Oil Rises as Fresh Mideast Flareups Counter Ample Supplies
item.description: Oil gained after fresh flareups in the Middle East, even with signs that supplies are outpacing demand.
item.dc:creator: Charles Gorrivan

item.title: Measles’ Comeback Could Be Just the Start
item.description: The US has lost its long-standing measles eradication status. And this may be just the first public health victory to unravel under Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s watch, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Lisa Jarvis says. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: México enfrenta trabas para atraer centros de datos de IA
item.description: México tiene ubicación, talento y cercanía con EE.UU. para convertirse en un polo de centros de datos. Pero una red eléctrica insuficiente y la burocracia amenazan con dejarlo atrás. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Russia's Oil Exports Hit Their Highest Since July as Drones Hit Refineries
item.description: A surge in Ukrainian attacks on oil-processing plants forced producers to divert crude to exports
item.dc:creator: Julian Lee

item.title: Exemplar Luxury CEO Says Growth Plan Is on Track
item.description: Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck says the Saks Fifth Avenue and Neiman Marcus parent company is profitable and aims to grow revenue from $7 billion to $9 billion. He talks about the demand for luxury goods, strengthening relationships with vendors and how the company is preparing for the holiday shopping season. He speaks with Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US Stock Selloff Loses Steam Ahead of Nvidia Test: Markets Wrap
item.description: A selloff in US stocks lost momentum as beaten-down technology shares drew buyers, with traders looking to Nvidia Corp.’s earnings after the close for a crucial read on the outlook for artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Andre Janse van Vuuren and Nil Codina Martinez

item.title: Todo lo que debe saber sobre la salida a bolsa de Anthropic
item.description: Anthropic se prepara para una de las mayores OPI de la historia, con una valoración que podría llegar a US$1,4 billones. Esto es lo que debe saber sobre su salida a bolsa. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Fed’s Musalem Says Economy to Likely Require ‘Several’ Hikes by Spring
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis President Alberto Musalem signaled support for multiple interest rate-increases in the coming months. He said, “the economy will likely require several interest rate increases before the spring of 2027 to achieve price stability in a timely manner” during comments Tuesday in Argentina. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Foreign Investors Pour Record $9.6 Billion Into Indian Stocks in November
item.description: Foreigners are turning into buyers of Indian stocks at a record pace, signaling a broader portfolio shift as the weakening artificial intelligence trade revives demand for a market investors had largely abandoned over the past two years.
item.dc:creator: Abhishek Vishnoi

item.title: Home Depot Names McPhail CEO With Decker Back as Chairman
item.description: Home Depot Inc. said Richard McPhail will take over as chief executive officer from Ted Decker, who is returning from medical leave to serve as chairman.
item.dc:creator: Redd Brown

item.title: ETF, CEF, Swap, Perp: Investors Get Slice of Anthropic Before IPO
item.description: Anthropic PBC’s much-anticipated Nasdaq debut isn’t expected until later this week, but retail traders are already finding ways to get a piece of the AI giant.
item.dc:creator: Yiqin Shen and Muyao Shen

item.title: Nasdaq 100 Futures Rise as Investors Prepare for Nvidia Results
item.description: Technology stocks climbed before the bell on Tuesday as investors prepared for an all-important earnings release from Nvidia Corp. and as a selloff in the artificial intelligence trade eased.
item.dc:creator: Joel Leon

item.title: Amazon, Google to Have About 28% of Anthropic Stock After IPO
item.description: Two of Anthropic PBC’s biggest customers will have more than 28% of its stock in aggregate after it goes public, adding to the close links between the companies powering the artificial intelligence boom.
item.dc:creator: David Morris

item.title: Hungary Holds Key Interest Rate as Global Risks Support Caution
item.description: Hungary left its key interest rate steady for a third month as central bankers assess an uptick in inflation against the backdrop of higher borrowing costs across the world.
item.dc:creator: Zoltan Simon and Thomas Escritt

item.title: Gold Steadies as Dip Buyers Cushion Slump Driven by Fed Concerns
item.description: Gold steadied as dip buyers brought some relief to a slump driven by concerns with stubborn US inflation and the AI selloff.
item.dc:creator: Yihui Xie

item.title: Disney Profit Beats With Marvel Films Powering Streaming
item.description: Walt Disney Co. reported sales and earnings that exceeded analysts’ expectations, with a particularly strong result in its streaming TV unit.
item.dc:creator: Christopher Palmeri

item.title: Private Equity Finds a Year-End Window to Take Cash Out of Firms
item.description: Private equity’s buyout machine may be idling as the year draws to a close, but sponsors are still finding ways to mint cash from the companies they own.
item.dc:creator: Claire Ruckin

item.title: Copper’s Unravelling AI Trade Collides With a Historic Squeeze
item.description: A growing divide between bearish investors and tight physical markets is creating a risky setup for metals.
item.dc:creator: Mark Burton
